aubergine-ink.$description: Aubergine Ink — Primary text, hero background, CTA button fill — the near-black with a warm violet undertone prevents the harshness of pure black while maintaining AAA contrast on cream

deep-plum.$description: Deep Plum — Hero section background variant, elevated surface in dark contexts

violet-mist.$description: Violet Mist — Section eyebrow labels ('AI ENGAGEMENT PLATFORM', 'DATA COLLECTION', 'INTEGRATIONS') — saturated purple used exclusively for categorical labeling, never on interactive elements

lavender-whisper.$description: Lavender Whisper — Subtle purple tints in light contexts, decorative highlights

cream-canvas.$description: Cream Canvas — Page background, light section backgrounds, reversed text on dark surfaces

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, integration logo pills, elevated elements in light sections

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text, ghost button borders and labels

slate-mid.$description: Slate Mid — Dividers, subtle borders in dark contexts

mist.$description: Mist — Light borders, dividers in cream backgrounds

parchment.$description: Parchment — Alternating section backgrounds, subtle surface differentiation from cream canvas

tobias.$description: Display and hero headlines exclusively. A classical editorial serif at weight 400 — most SaaS sites use a geometric sans at 700+ for headlines; Tobias at regular weight makes Typeform's headings feel authored, not announced. The tight negative tracking (-1.98px at 64px, -2.24px at 72px, -2.48px at 80px) is essential — without it, the serif reads loose and archaic.

twk-lausanne.$description: Bold emphasis in body contexts, strong labels.
